competitors.name: Palermo Villa / Connie's
competitors.action: Palermo rolled out a new Connie's wood-fired frozen pizza line built around 24-hour fermented dough, wood-fired baking, premium all-natural toppings, and a $10.99 price point. The high-signal takeaway for Real Dough is that a scaled incumbent is leaning harder into artisan process language and premium crust architecture rather than competing on value alone.

competitors.name: One Planet Pizza / Asda
competitors.action: One Planet Pizza passed £1 million in annualized retail sales, grew year over year sales by more than 100%, and added a third Asda line with a sourdough cheezy garlic flatbread. For Real Dough, this is a strong proof point that freezer buyers are still rewarding differentiated crust-led pizza brands when the product expands beyond a single core SKU.

competitors.name: Veggies Made Great
competitors.action: Veggies Made Great entered frozen pastries with Fruit Pockets rolling into Target, Hy-Vee, Giant, Stop & Shop, Harris Teeter, and later Publix at a $5.99 SRP. Even outside pizza, the move is a useful freezer-set signal: retailers are still opening space for better-for-you comfort formats that smuggle in vegetables while staying familiar and easy to shop.

trends.topic: Frozen comfort food premiumization is accelerating through artisan process cues and adjacency expansion
trends.magnitude: Palermo launched 4 wood-fired Connie's SKUs at $10.99 while One Planet added a third Asda line after surpassing £1M annualized retail sales
trends.context: The clearest daily signal is that frozen brands are winning with restaurant-quality cues like fermentation, wood-firing, sourdough, and premium toppings, then extending into adjacent freezer occasions once brand traction is proven.

breaking.headline: Today's strongest freezer signal: premium crust/process storytelling is still creating room to grow, and brands are using that momentum to branch into adjacent comfort formats.
breaking.impact: Palermo's wood-fired Connie's launch and One Planet's sourdough-led retail momentum both reinforce that shoppers will pay attention to authentic at-home pizza cues, while Veggies Made Great shows the broader freezer set is still rewarding better-for-you comfort innovation.
